prompt.zh-TW: 雲梯軟體的人均營收比同業高出不少。這個指標告訴你的是什麼？
prompt.en: Cloud Ladder Software’s revenue per employee is well above its peers’. What does this indicator tell you?

text.zh-TW: 平均每位員工替公司做出多少營收，也就是人力的產出
text.en: How much revenue each employee generates on average, that is, the output per person

feedback.zh-TW: 答對了。人均營收 ＝ 營收 ÷ 員工人數，看的是人力運用的效率；員工人數不是報表上的數字，要另外輸入。
feedback.en: Correct. Revenue per employee = revenue ÷ headcount, a measure of how productively people are used; the headcount is not on the statements and has to be entered separately.

text.zh-TW: 公司很賺錢，因為每位員工都帶進很多錢
text.en: The company is very profitable, because every employee brings in a lot of money

feedback.zh-TW: 人均營收只看營收，沒有扣成本與費用。營收高但成本也高的公司，人均營收亮眼、淨利卻可能很薄；要判斷賺不賺錢，還要配合純益率。
feedback.en: Revenue per employee looks only at revenue, before any costs or expenses. A company with high revenue and high costs can have an impressive figure and a thin profit; pair it with the net profit margin to judge profitability.

text.zh-TW: 每位員工平均領到多少薪水，也就是人事成本的高低
text.en: How much each employee is paid on average, that is, how high staff costs are

feedback.zh-TW: 分子是營收，不是薪資費用。薪資怎麼分配是另一個問題，這個指標看不出來。
feedback.en: The numerator is revenue, not wages. How pay is distributed is a separate question that this indicator cannot answer.

explanation.zh-TW: {{option:o_5tg0}}。人均營收的分母是員工人數，不是金額，三張報表上找不到，要另外輸入。外包比例高的公司帳上人數少，人均營收自然偏高；而且它只看營收、沒有扣成本與費用，衡量的是人力的產出，不是獲利。要知道賺不賺錢，還是要回到純益率與 ROE。
explanation.en: {{option:o_5tg0}}. The denominator of revenue per employee is the headcount, not an amount of money, so it cannot be found on the three statements and has to be entered separately. A company that outsources a lot has fewer staff on its books, so its figure is naturally higher; and since it looks only at revenue, before costs and expenses, it measures output per person, not profit. To judge profitability, go back to the net profit margin and ROE.
